verdict.rationale: Formant documents some fleet-scope actions. Analytics can run across a fleet by device group or tag. Device configuration can be saved as a template or exported to YAML, implying reuse across devices. A single operator view can manage multiple fleets and group views span multiple devices. However, no evidence shows bulk write actions such as sending one command to many devices, mass-editing configs, or bulk API endpoints. Commands are documented per device via button click or event trigger. Missing for 10: documented bulk command dispatch across devices, bulk configuration apply/update across a group, bulk API/SDK endpoints, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
